2017–18 basketball game excitement

2017–18 basketball · Pregame inputs

Before Excitement Value (BEV) rates pregame appeal using CORS ranks and the projected margin. After Excitement Value (AEV) measures score-and-clock drama over two halves, with lead changes, comebacks and overtime. Both use a 0–100 scale. Six points is a two-possession margin. A dash means the scoring evidence is insufficient.
